data.name: Domitiana
data.gender_notes: Domitiana is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman family name ‘Domitius’. It means ‘belonging to Dominus (Lord)’ in Latin. The name Domitiana carries the meaning “Follower of Dominus (Lord)” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Domitiana usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of dominus (lord) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes devotion and faith in God.
data.etymology: Domitiana belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of Dominus (Lord).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Domitiana total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: דומיטיאנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דומיטיאנה נגזרת מהמילה הלטינית 'דומיטוס' שפירושה 'כבוש' או 'מושפל', והסיומת '-אנה' שפירושה 'שייכת ל-' או 'נושאת את שם-'. לפיכך, דומיטיאנה יכולה להתפרש כ'כבושה למשמעת אלוהים' או 'צייתנית לרצונו של אלוהים'. השם מופיע ברשימות השמות הנוצריות הקדומות, ומשמש לעתים קרובות כסמל של צייתנות וכניעה לאלוהים.

in_greek.name: Δομιτιανή
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Δομιτιανή προέρχεται από το λατινικό 'Domitianus', που σημαίνει 'του Δομίτιος' ή 'απόγονος του Δομίτιος'. Η μορφή Δομιτιανή είναι πιθανότατα Ελληνική εκδοχή του ονόματος, που σημαίνει 'δοκιμασμένη και πιστή στο Θεό'. Στην Εκκλησία τα ονόματα αυτά ήταν συχνά επιλεγμένα για να εκφράζουν την πίστη και την αφοσίωση στον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Domitiana
in_latin.meaning: Tamed or subdued; belonging to Domitian
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Domitiana is derived from 'Domitianus', meaning 'of Domitius' or 'descendant of Domitius'. The suffix '-ana' implies possession or belonging. Hence, Domitiana can be interpreted as 'tamed or subdued; belonging to Domitian'. In early Christian tradition, such names often signified humility and submission to divine will.

in_english.name: Domitiana
in_english.meaning: Tamed or subdued; devoted to God
in_english.long_meaning: The name Domitiana originates from the Latin 'Domitianus', meaning 'of Domitius'. The suffix '-ana' denotes belonging. Domitiana signifies 'tamed' or 'subdued', reflecting a spiritual devotion to God. Historically, it was used in Christian tradition to denote humility and obedience. The name conveys a sense of piety and spiritual discipline, echoing New Testament values of self-control and faithfulness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Domitiana" was popular among the Roman nobility during ancient times. Its bearing was a sign of Roman heritage and nobility. The name continued to be used in the Christian era, particularly in the early Church where many saints bore this name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Domitiana" reminds us of the Lord's dominion and sovereignty over our lives. It is a reminder that as Christians, our ultimate allegiance is to God, our Lord, and Savior. By bearing the name, one is declaring their commitment to serving and surrendering themselves to the Lord's will. Additionally, it is a reminder of the importance of prayer, as we seek to live our lives in accordance with His divine plan. Ultimately, the name "Domitiana" invites us to live our lives with a deep sense of humility, reverence, and devotion to the Lord.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Domitiana: Dedicated to the Divine Mother, bearing the strength and nurturing qualities of the goddess Domitia.

It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.
